summary: Frontend-only UI/UX verification of Bust-A-Lead pass 5. Verified: (1) Desktop 1280x800 player-hand dock at y=668-788 (not clipped), action-bar floats at y=551 above cards at y=690 (no overlap). (2) Desktop fan renders 25 card buttons with card-<suit>-<rank>-<index> testids; mobile suit tabs are hidden via lg breakpoint. (3) Mobile 390x844 suit tabs render — suit-tab-ALL(25), S(9), H(8), D(3), C(5); tapping suit-tab-S filters mobile grid to spades only (9 cards); tapping suit-tab-ALL restores full grid. (4) Auction transparency working — bubble-W shows 'West: Bid $70' and bubble-E shows 'East: Pass'; auction-log shows High Bid + leader. (5) contract-badge appears during play with trump symbol, Contract, Meld, Books to Save 31/Target 50. (6) meld-rack renders with played-card greying. Aces badge appeared for East (Aces Declared) during play — glowing yellow badge under avatar. (7) new-game-header-btn opens new-game-modal; cancel-new-game-btn closes without reset; confirm-new-game-btn resets all bankrolls to $100.00 (W/E/P), deals a fresh hand, no stuck state. (8) Regression pass: trick-counter shows 'Book 1/25', no false BUSTED, no blank screen. All new testids are in place. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: HandTray: desktop fan uses `hidden lg:flex` so its DOM (25 cards) remains present at mobile widths — harmless visually but could confuse a11y/tab-focus if not display:none-safe. Consider conditionally rendering to reduce duplicate testid matches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids verified: new-game-header-btn, new-game-modal, confirm-new-game-btn, cancel-new-game-btn, suit-tab-{ALL,S,H,D,C}, suit-count-{...}, bubble-{W,E,P}, auction-log, contract-badge, aces-badge-{W,E,P}. Note: [data-testid^='card-'] also picks up hidden desktop fan DOM at mobile widths — use visibility checks or scope by ancestor to count truly visible cards.
